description: This file defines a partial struct 'Writer' with generic type parameter 'TBufferWriter' in the 'Orleans.Serialization.Buffers' namespace. It includes methods for writing variable-width integer types (signed and unsigned), using ZigZag encoding for signed integers and efficient varint encoding. The functions are optimized with aggressive inlining.

classes.name: Writer<TBufferWriter>
classes.description: A partial struct providing methods for writing variable-sized integers with ZigZag encoding.

methods.name: WriteVarUInt8
methods.description: Writes an unsigned byte with variable-width encoding.

methods.name: WriteVarUInt16
methods.description: Writes an unsigned short with variable-width encoding.

methods.name: ZigZagEncode
methods.description: Encodes a signed int or long using ZigZag encoding to optimize varint representation.
